pages.name: King's Indian: Smyslov System
pages.notes: Overview called the g5-bishop light-squared and the Bg5 a pin; plans repeated the already played ...h6 and named ...g5 before the bishop had moved. Rewritten with the 6.Bh4 g5 7.Bg3 Nh5 line.

pages.name: Amar Opening: Paris Gambit, Gent Gambit
pages.notes: Plans had White attacking on the h-file with Ng5 against f7, with no knight able to reach g5. Rewritten around White's real compensation (bishop pair, half-open f-file, h3-bishop on d7) and Black's ...Bc5+.

pages.name: Grob: 1...d5
pages.notes: Plans had Black challenging g4 with ...h5 and attacking f4/h4, missing that 1...d5 already attacks g4 with the c8-bishop. Rewritten around 2.Bg2 Bxg4 3.c4 and Qb3.

pages.name: Grob: 1...d5
pages.notes: Plans repeated 2.e4 and 2...dxe4 as future moves and suggested queenside castling. Overview now notes the queen guards g4 after 2.e4; plans rewritten around Nc3/Bg2 against e4 and ...h5.

pages.name: Grob: 1...d5
pages.notes: A ...h5-h4 push that cannot follow with the h3-pawn there; plans tightened and British spelling.

pages.name: Hungarian Opening: Paris Gambit
pages.notes: Plans had a queen lift Qe1-g1 onto the king's square and an open g-file that is closed. Rewritten around Rxf4/gxf4, the half-open f-file and Black's ...fxg3 transposition to the Gent Gambit; reviewer rejection fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Hungarian Opening: Symmetrical Variation
pages.notes: Plans read the a1-h8 diagonal as a move and had no side prefixes. Rewritten with White:/Black: plans and the brief's transpositions.

pages.name: Kádas Opening: Beginner's Trap
pages.notes: Misread the line: 2.Rh3 hangs the rook to 2...Bxh3, but the page described it as White provoking Bxh3 for a g-file attack. Rewritten: Black wins the exchange.

pages.name: Mieses Opening
pages.notes: Plans claimed Black's reversed King's Indian set-up gains a move in hand (White has the extra tempo), called a d3 set-up a Colle and proposed an f4-f5 storm in the KIA. Rewritten.

pages.name: Polish Opening: Orangutan-Diemer Gambit
pages.notes: Plans used 0-0 for castling and generic text; rewritten around Nxf3 hitting e5, the b2-bishop, Nb5 against the d6-queen and Black's consolidation.
